# EVEShip.fit

> View, create and share EVE Online ship fits. The website needs JavaScript; to calculate fits from an AI assistant, use the EVEShip.fit MCP server.

## MCP server

- [EVEShip.fit for your AI](https://mcp.eveship.fit/): how to add the MCP server at `https://mcp.eveship.fit/mcp` to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and others. It calculates damage, tank, capacitor, speed, targeting and fitting with the same engine as the website.

## Linking to a fit

- [A Rifter, as a DNA link](https://eveship.fit/?fit=dna:587::): `https://eveship.fit/?fit=dna:<DNA>` opens a fit in DNA format, and `https://eveship.fit/?fit=killmail:<id>/<hash>` the fit of a killmail.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/EVEShipFit/eveship.fit): the website and its packages.
- [Embedding](https://github.com/EVEShipFit/eveship.fit/blob/main/docs/embedding.md): show the fitting wheel on your own site.
